fields.description: System-generated unique identifier for this installed unit, used to reference it across service jobs and reports.
fields.label: Equipment ID

fields.description: Human-friendly name for the equipment as technicians and customers refer to it on site.
fields.label: Equipment Name

fields.description: Current lifecycle state of the unit, from pending installation through active service to removal or disposal.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Pending Installation
Active
Inactive
Removed
Returned
Replaced
Disposed

fields.description: Unique QR token printed on the unit so technicians can scan it in the field to open its record.
fields.label: QR Token

fields.description: Physical asset tag or sticker number affixed to the equipment for on-site identification.
fields.label: Asset Tag

fields.description: Legal company that owns or services this equipment, used for accounting and access scoping.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: Customer account at whose premises this equipment is installed and serviced.
fields.label: Customer

fields.description: Specific customer site or branch location where the equipment is physically installed.
fields.label: Customer Site

fields.description: Precise location within the site (room, floor, or zone) where the unit is mounted.
fields.label: Equipment Location

fields.description: Linked catalog item that defines the make and model of this installed unit.
fields.label: Item

fields.description: Descriptive item name pulled from the linked catalog item.
fields.label: Item Name

fields.description: Product category of the item, inherited from the item master for grouping and filtering.
fields.label: Item Group

fields.description: Manufacturer brand of the item, inherited from the item master.
fields.label: Brand

fields.description: Unique manufacturer serial number tracked for this specific physical unit.
fields.label: Serial No

fields.description: Manufacturing or supply batch this unit belongs to, for traceability and recalls.
fields.label: Batch

fields.description: Number of units this record represents, normally one per tracked asset.
fields.label: Installed Quantity

fields.description: Sales order through which this equipment was originally sold to the customer.
fields.label: Sales Order

fields.description: Specific line item on the sales order that corresponds to this unit.
fields.label: Sales Order Item

fields.description: Delivery note under which the unit was shipped and handed over to the customer.
fields.label: Delivery Note

fields.description: Specific delivery note line item that recorded the dispatch of this unit.
fields.label: Delivery Note Item

fields.description: Sales invoice that billed the customer for this equipment.
fields.label: Sales Invoice

fields.description: Date the unit was delivered to the customer site.
fields.label: Delivery Date

fields.description: Date the technician physically installed and mounted the unit on site.
fields.label: Installation Date

fields.description: Date the unit was tested and formally put into operational service.
fields.label: Commissioning Date

fields.description: Date the manufacturer or service warranty coverage begins.
fields.label: Warranty Start

fields.description: Date the warranty coverage expires and chargeable service applies.
fields.label: Warranty End

fields.description: Whether the unit is currently under active warranty, expired, or not covered.
fields.label: Warranty Status

fields.description: Indicates the unit is eligible for scheduled maintenance and service visits.
fields.label: Serviceable

fields.description: Date of the most recent completed service or maintenance visit.
fields.label: Last Service Date

fields.description: Reference to the most recent service job carried out on this unit.
fields.label: Last Service Job

fields.description: Reference to the most recent on-site service visit for this unit.
fields.label: Last Service Visit

fields.description: Name of the company that manufactured the equipment.
fields.label: Manufacturer

fields.description: Manufacturer model number of the equipment.
fields.label: Model No

fields.description: Free-text directions helping technicians find the exact spot of the unit on site.
fields.label: Exact Location Notes

fields.description: Functional category of the equipment that drives which service rules and fields apply.
fields.label: Equipment Category
fields.options:
General
Fire Extinguisher
Fire Alarm
Fire Pump
Hose Reel
Sprinkler
Emergency Light
Fire Door

fields.description: Extinguishing agent class of a fire extinguisher, determining its suitable fire types.
fields.label: Extinguisher Type
fields.options:
Water
Foam
Dry Chemical Powder
CO2
Wet Chemical
Clean Agent

fields.description: Rated capacity of the extinguisher, such as the weight or volume of its agent.
fields.label: Capacity

fields.description: Unit of measure in which the extinguisher capacity is expressed.
fields.label: Capacity UOM

fields.description: Specific extinguishing agent contained in the unit as printed on its nameplate.
fields.label: Agent Type

fields.description: Manufacturer name as shown on the fire equipment nameplate.
fields.label: Nameplate Manufacturer

fields.description: Model designation as shown on the fire equipment nameplate.
fields.label: Nameplate Model

fields.description: Date the fire unit was manufactured, used to calculate its service life.
fields.label: Manufacturing Date

fields.description: Date after which the fire unit must be retired or replaced.
fields.label: Expiry Date

fields.description: Rated operating pressure of the fire unit as certified by the manufacturer.
fields.label: Pressure Rating

fields.description: Number of months between mandatory hydrostatic pressure tests for this unit.
fields.label: Hydro Test Interval (Months)

fields.description: Date the extinguisher was last recharged or refilled with agent.
fields.label: Last Refill Date

fields.description: Outcome of the most recent refill or recharge operation.
fields.label: Last Refill Result

fields.description: Date the unit last passed a hydrostatic pressure test.
fields.label: Last Hydro Test Date

fields.description: Date the next hydrostatic pressure test is due for this unit.
fields.label: Hydro Due Date

fields.description: Photograph of the installed unit for identification and condition reference.
fields.label: Equipment Photo

fields.description: How this equipment record was created, such as from a delivery note, import, or manual entry.
fields.label: Source
fields.options:
Delivery Note
Manual
Import
Installation
Migration

fields.description: Internal key used to link this unit to its automated provisioning or onboarding process.
fields.label: Provisioning Key

fields.description: General free-text notes and remarks about this equipment.
fields.label: Notes
